_meta.description: Known-infrastructure IP lists: one index per list (redelk-iplist-redteam, -customer, -blueteam, -unknown, -tor). Documents are written by modules/enrich_synciplists and modules/enrich_tor as {@timestamp, iplist:{name, source, ip, comment}}. The priority is above the redelk-* template because a composable index template does not merge with a lower priority one, it replaces it. The pre-v3 template matched iplist-* and mapped flat ip/list/source fields, which no document in RedELK has ever had.
